mission: Acquire and stage the operator-approved utility who-serves territory set only. No rail, cells, atoms, product surface, or tier work.

contract_check.notes: Acquisition and deployment-Neon staging are slot-free. No PostGIS/full-table scan is planned. L16 retains the atoms slot and DB writer lease.

schema_design.grain: one source polygon or multipolygon feature
schema_design.h1_mirror: GeoJSON geometry and EPSG:4326 bbox, immutable source identity, full passthrough attribute bag, source URL/layer/fetch/vintage/citation/tier, non-empty source_tier_satisfied check, PK plus source/county/bbox indexes.
schema_design.write_pattern: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, then parameterized inserts/upserts in batches no larger than 250 rows. No delete/truncate. Existing source rows, if any, must be reconciled before replacement.

sources.acquisition_gate: curl-equivalent retries, HTTP success, non-zero bytes, Python zipfile testzip() is null, shapefile parse count equals source count
curl-equivalent retries, HTTP success, non-zero bytes, Python zipfile testzip() is null, shapefile parse count equals source count
live returnCountOnly equals fetched feature count; page by object ID; outSR=4326
live returnCountOnly equals fetched feature count; page by object ID; outSR=4326

sources.reconciliation_rule: Compare normalized live TCEQ district IDs against tx_special_district district_id. Stage only source features whose district subject is absent. Never copy a district already represented in tx_special_district. Report source rows, represented IDs, additive IDs, and the exact normalization/counting rule.

coverage_proof.rule: Use source-returned county attributes and ArcGIS groupBy/count statistics where available. PUCT shapefile COUNTY values are grouped after integrity-verified parse. Do not use extent metadata. Do not run PostGIS.
coverage_proof.null_county_rule: Report null/blank/multi-county attribute rows separately; do not infer county from extent.
coverage_proof.counting_rule: Per-source staged rows count source features after source filter and additive reconciliation. County coverage is COUNT(DISTINCT normalized source county label/FIPS), excluding null/blank; raw group counts are retained.

pre_registered_acceptance.item: Both PUCT zips pass HTTP, byte, zipfile testzip, shapefile component, and parsed row-count gates before any PUCT staging write.
HIFLD and TWDB live returnCountOnly values equal complete fetched and staged counts; no extent-derived count is accepted.
Every staged row has source URL, source layer, fetch timestamp, vintage, citation, non-empty satisfied tier, EPSG:4326 geometry, Texas-valid bbox, and full source attributes.
County coverage proof is source-attribute/groupBy based with the counting rule and null/multi-county residue stated per source.
TCEQ is reconciled by normalized district subject against tx_special_district; only genuinely additive subjects stage and no second copy of represented subjects is created.
No atoms writes, slot, lease, rail declaration, cells, product surface, product/tier work, PostGIS, or heavy scan occurs.

adversarial_traps: A valid zip response can still be corrupt or HTML; parse only after zipfile integrity passes.
ArcGIS maxRecordCount can silently truncate; count, page, and reconcile object IDs.
PUCT county text may contain multi-county strings; preserve raw attributes and state the normalization rule.
CCN/PWS/electric territory means who-serves posture, not parcel serviceability.
TCEQ row count and tx_special_district row count have different grains; reconcile distinct normalized district subjects, not raw polygon rows.
Never infer coverage from service extent.
